name: mechanics
attribution: hogwash house-mechanics pack (MIT). Punctuation and length rules a writer sets for their own prose; off by default, enabled by naming "mechanics" in hogwash.json packs.

rules.message: Em dash. It is the most-copied machine punctuation there is. Use a full stop, a colon, or a pair of commas.

matching: the plan — such as it was — held
clean: the plan, such as it was, held

rules.message: En dash used as a connector. A range between two numbers is fine; a pause in a sentence is not. Use a full stop, a colon, or commas.

matching: the build – slow as it is – passed

rules.message: Spaced hyphen standing in for a dash. Same pause, same problem. Use a full stop, a colon, or commas.

matching: the build - slow as it is - passed

rules.message: More than one comma in this sentence. Two clauses is the sentence's job; a third wants its own sentence.

matching: The build ran, the tests passed, and the deploy went out.
clean: The build ran and the tests passed. The deploy went out.

rules.message: Paragraph runs past three sentences. Break it, or cut what the reader does not need.
